summary: Iter-25 verification — 41/41 backend pytest cases PASS (26 new iter25 + 15 iter24 regression). Bucket A (server.py refactor into modular package): BEHAVIOR PRESERVED. All previously-exercised endpoints continue to work identically — /api/auth/login (200 + access_token + user), /api/auth/me (includes nutrient_unit; value is 'mEq' by default, still matches iter19 contract), all 6 legacy guides (/fruits, /beverages, /vegetables, /snacks, /proteins, /grains) return {GREEN,YELLOW,RED} with title/subtitle/<entries>[], /api/foods returns 1000+ items, /api/foods/food-apple returns {food:{id:'food-apple',...}}, /api/meal-logs summary + /api/reports/weekly both return limits.fluid_ml>0, doctor override PATCH /api/auth/profile {doctor_limits:{fluid_ml:1500}} works and null restores stage default (2000 for demo user), meal-log CRUD round-trip, favorites toggle, /api/ai/ask 200 with answer. Slowapi rate-limiter (5/minute on /auth/login) still fires on 6th call. Bucket B (NEW /api/oils/guide + expanded proteins): /api/oils/guide returns GREEN(6)/YELLOW(3)/RED(4) each with title/subtitle/oils[]; every entry has name/hindi/serving/potassium_mg/sodium_mg/note plus derived potassium_meq (via guide_utils.enrich_guide, mg/39.1) and high_sodium (bool, threshold 400 mg Na). GREEN oils include Mustard/Groundnut/Sunflower/Rice Bran/Desi Ghee/Unsalted Butter — all potassium_mg∈{0,1}. RED includes Salted Butter (sodium_mg=40), Vanaspati/Dalda, Margarine (spread tubs). IFCT 2017 codes present as `source` on all new entries. /api/proteins/guide YELLOW now includes the 4 new dals (Chana/Urad/Whole Green Moong/Kala Chana, all with cooked-leaching source note) + 2 new dairy (Plain Curd/Dahi, Buttermilk/Chaas unsalted) — all with high_sodium=false. /api/proteins/guide RED includes Salted Lassi (250 ml, 450 mg Na) and Sweetened Condensed Milk. Iter24 regression suite passes untouched (all 15 tests) confirming the scan grounding + fluid budget fixes still hold.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py refactor is CLEAN — 74 lines composition entrypoint with re-exports (app, db, _extract_json) preserved for iter24 tests. Route package uses a factory build_api_router() to keep unit-test imports side-effect-free.
Every new /oils entry cites IFCT 2017 code (J001-J007, L011-L014). Every new dal entry cites the ~2.4x cooked-leaching conversion factor from the protein_guide.py preamble — good sourcing trail.

Note (not a bug, informational): via the public k8s ingress URL, slowapi's get_remote_address may occasionally see the same forwarded IP, so the rate-limit window is shared across all callers. On this test run 6 rapid public-URL logins tripped 429. If future testing sees flakiness, main agent could switch to slowapi's ProxyHeadersMiddleware-aware key_func — not required now.
